name: Downtown 19 A 1BDR
headline: The Majestic Marrakesh Studio @ Cairo's Downtown (19A)
summary: This Moroccan themed studio is located at the heart of Downtown Cairo, 250 meters away from the iconic Tahrir Square. The studio is an 8 min walk from the Egyptian Museum and is surrounded with all kinds of restaurants and cafes. The studio apartment features a comfortable queen size bed, a 55 inch smart TV, cozy bathroom and a fully loaded kitchenette.

description.Space:
The Moroccan themed studio features a queen size comfortable bed. It also features a fully loaded kitchenette, microwave, a stove top with cooking utensils, a kettle and a Nespresso coffee machine. Additionally, guests can enjoy a 55 inch smart TV for further personal entertainment. 

Please note the following: 
- Smoking is only allowed in the balcony or outside the building (a fine of $100 will be imposed when smoking indoors) 
- Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests will be granted entry. 

The styling of the apartment is tailored to give the guests an authentic oriental experience themed with a Moroccan vibe.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment.
description.Interaction:
We are more than happy to answer all of your questions 24/7. Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Neighborhood:
Cairo's Downtown is a busy neighborhood packed with a lot of places to explore and enjoy:

- The Egyptian Museum is an 8 minute walk.
- Tahrir Square is a 3 minute walk.
- Cairo International Airport is a 35 minute drive.
- Giza Pyramids is a 35 minute drive
description.Transit: We provide concierge services that include airport transfers and private day tours.
description.Notes:
Please note the following: 
- Smoking is only allowed in the balcony or outside the building (a fine of $100 will be imposed when smoking indoors) 
- Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests will be granted entry.

location_address1: 15 Al Bustan St, Bab Al Louq, Abdeen, Cairo Governorate 4280120
agreement:
Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 100 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 


Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

Das Studio liegt im 7. OG eines Wohnhauses, 2 Minuten zu Fuß vom Tahrir. Der Pflegezustand des Hauses ist gewöhnungsbedürftig für Nordeuropäer, aber wenn immer alles wie zu Hause sein soll, muss man eben auch dort bleiben. Das Studio ist aber modern und einwandfrei. Es gibt ein gemütliches (für uns etwas zu weiches) Bett, eine Sitzecke, Garderobe, Küchenzeile und natürlich das schöne Bad. Es gibt eine Aircon. Wir empfehlen, eine dünne Decke oder Hüttenschlafsack mitzubringen, denn die Doppeldecke und die Fleecedecke sind doch schon sehr dick. In der Küche ist alles, was man für „die kleine Versorgung“ braucht, es war Kaffee und Tee für den ersten Tag da. Ausstattung: Spüle mit Spülmittel, Geschirr etc. für 2, Mikrowelle, Doppelherdplatte, Wasserkocher, Kühlschrank. Im Bad ist eine Regendusche, Waschbecken & Toilette mit Shampoo, Duschgel, Handseife und Toilettenpapier. Die Kommunikation mit dem Team von Xuxu war sehr nett und einfach. Wir empfehlen diese Unterkunft 100% weiter!

My stay was amazing. this Marrakech studio was beautifully decorated. right in Cairo's downtown the location was just perfect to go anywhere within the city, the pyramids and the airport. any tourist service con pick you up or drop you off from that direction. 

my host suggested bob as a tour guide, you should try him, he was great, friendly and very affordable compared to others. also I suggest him for you transfer airport to Airbnb since outside the airport it's a bit chaotic and it could be overwhelming for you.

I went out to walk around the area everyday at all times and felt completely safe, and phone at hand. Egyptian hospitality is 10/10. 

back to the unit, they offered coffee pods, tea, water and toiletry. AC works fine and the balcony doors block most of not all the city noise.

I really liked the place, not only it was sparkly clean but also it had aesthetic interiors according Marrakesh theme.

Things that gave me hiccups:
- the security guard kinda scares you initially, but don't go by his looks and how he's dressed. He's very helpful. would have been good if knew English well 

- they have a gas based water heater whose supply gets turned off during night. so if you have to take shower early in the morning, you won't get hot water. I had to leave for airport at 5am and had to take shower with really cold water. 

other than these two things, the place is just awesome. I like the fact that you don't have to interact any other human being (except the guard), and I appreciated this especially in Egypt where everyone tries to sell their services.

I absolutely loved the location of this unit, literally in the heart of the city, lots to see and do. The communication was pristine and Hadeer was always so responsive and helpful, I'm so thankful for that. The unit was as described and it was very cute. Only downside is there was no storage space. The downsides were we didn't have hot water for the first two days of our 4 day stay, finally on day 3 this got fixed but on day 4 the ceiling started leaking. Η Xury Stays έκανε το περιπετειώδες ταξίδι μας να έχει μια νότα ηρεμίας και γαλήνης! Το check in ήταν πολύ εύκολο, παρόλο που φτάσαμε στο διαμέρισμα μας πολύ αργά τα μεσάνυχτα. Το δωμάτιο ήταν άνετο, καθαρό και παρείχε ο,τι χρειαζόμασταν. Η επικοινωνία ήταν πάντα άμεση και είχαμε την ευκολία να ζητήσουμε ο,τι χρειαζόμασταν. Η τοποθεσία είναι σε πολυ κεντρικό σημείο και παρέχει ασφάλεια ακόμα και πολύ αργά το βράδυ. Ο κύριος που φυλάει το κτήριο είναι πάρα πολύ γλυκός και ευγενικός! Η μόνωση του σπιτιού εξαιρετική παρόλο που είναι σε πολύ κεντρικό δρόμο-δεν ακούγεται τίποτα από έξω. Το μόνο που θα ήταν καλό να φτιαχτεί, είναι οι μυρωδιές που βγαίνουν απ το μπάνιο και τα νερά που βγαίνουν έξω από τη ντουζιέρα! Ηταν λίγο ενοχλητικό να μυρίζει το σπίτι όταν γυρνούσαμε από μια κουραστική μέρα αλλά δε μας δημιούργησε παραπάνω πρόβλημα. Προτιμήστε αυτό το διαμέρισμα και θα βγείτε κερδισμένοι! Σας ευχαριστούμε για όλα και θα τα πούμε σύντομα ❤️

Unfortunately, our experience was very disappointing. The apartment had a very strong chemical smell, similar to insect poison, which made it impossible to stay inside for long. It caused nausea and dizziness, and even after keeping the balcony open all day, the smell didn’t go away. The host was very nice and in touch but offered only an air freshener, which wouldn't help with this problem.

We eventually had to leave the keys and move to another hotel because the place was not habitable. On top of that, the apartment was quite dirty, not properly cleaned, and it requires urgent renovation. This is not how a living space should smell or be maintained.

Additionally, the apartment faces a busy street, and it’s extremely noisy at all hours - I honestly can’t imagine how anyone could sleep there. I strongly recommend choosing accommodation in another area if you want a comfortable and peaceful stay.

I am surprised that the host has only good reviews and such high ratings.
